svg.title: Join the lobby with a parked player
svg.desc: Ada plays on the page and opens a lobby on Autodarts at the board of the display. On that page, the tile of each parked player in the popup and in the switcher offers Join the lobby. A tap on Bob's, or later on Join again below his tile, renews his parked session and keeps the rotated token first. When his session is dead or Autodarts can't be reached, his tile says why and nothing else changes. Otherwise the extension reads the lobby with his own access token, which never reaches the page. When Bob sits there already, the popup says so and Autodarts gets no second seat. Otherwise the extension seats Bob at the board of the display. When Autodarts refuses the seat because the lobby is full, closed or started, the popup says so. Otherwise his tile says In the lobby, with Join again below it for when the host takes him out, the page stays with Ada without a switch or a reload, and the match counts for both accounts.
